CREATE TABLE organizations (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	internal_code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	service_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (internal_code)
)

CREATE TABLE domain_modules (
	code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	data_owner VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_independently_deployable BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE staff_job_codes (
	code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE roles (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_assignable BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,

)

	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	client_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	attempted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE organization_units (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	parent_unit_id UUID, 
	unit_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	internal_code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE staff_position_codes (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	internal_code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_staff_position_organization_code UNIQUE (organization_id, internal_code), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_staff_position_organization_name UNIQUE (organization_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(organization_id) REFERENCES organizations (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_staff_position_organization_active ON staff_position_codes (organization_id, is_active)

CREATE TABLE staff (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	internal_code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	job_title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	position_title VARCHAR(100), 
	employment_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	is_test_data BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

	CONSTRAINT uq_staff_organization_code UNIQUE (organization_id, internal_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(organization_id) REFERENCES organizations (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_staff_organization_status ON staff (organization_id, employment_status)

CREATE TABLE staff_source_accounts (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	staff_id UUID, 
	source_system VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	service_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	display_name_snapshot VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	job_name_snapshot VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	employment_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	source_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,

CREATE INDEX ix_staff_source_accounts_staff_status ON staff_source_accounts (staff_id, employment_status)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL,

	username VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

	must_change_password BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	password_changed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_login_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,

	FOREIGN KEY(organization_id) REFERENCES organizations (id),

CREATE TABLE rooms (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	internal_code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	floor VARCHAR(60), 
	floor_unit_id UUID, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_recipient_room_code UNIQUE (organization_id, internal_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(organization_id) REFERENCES organizations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(floor_unit_id) REFERENCES organization_units (id)
)

CREATE TABLE staff_service_periods (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	staff_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source_account_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	start_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	end_date DATE, 
	employment_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_staff_service_periods_open_account ON staff_service_periods (source_account_id) WHERE end_date IS NULL

CREATE TABLE staff_organization_assignments (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	staff_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	unit_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	unit_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	start_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	end_date DATE, 
	note TEXT NOT NULL, 
	is_test_data BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

	updated_by UUID,

CREATE TABLE staff_job_assignments (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	staff_id UUID NOT NULL,

	job_title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	position_title VARCHAR(100),

	FOREIGN KEY(staff_id) REFERENCES staff (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_code) REFERENCES staff_job_codes (code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_staff_job_assignments_history ON staff_job_assignments (staff_id, start_date, end_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_staff_job_assignments_open_primary ON staff_job_assignments (staff_id) WHERE is_primary = true AND end_date IS NULL

CREATE TABLE user_roles (
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	role_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES roles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE recipients (

	organization_id UUID NOT NULL,

	display_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	room_id UUID, 
	service_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_test_data BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_recipient_organization_code UNIQUE (organization_id, internal_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(organization_id) REFERENCES organizations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES rooms (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_recipients_active_room ON recipients (organization_id, is_active, room_id)

CREATE TABLE recipient_sync_batches (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	original_name VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	file_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE staff_hub_rooms (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	room_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	unit_id UUID, 
	resident_scope_unit_id UUID, 
	job_code VARCHAR(80), 
	owner_staff_id UUID, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	resident_scope VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_test_data BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_by UUID, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL,

	CONSTRAINT staff_hub_rooms_type_check CHECK (room_type IN ('all', 'business', 'department', 'floor', 'team', 'job', 'custom', 'self', 'ai', 'living_space')),

	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_staff_hub_rooms_ai ON staff_hub_rooms (organization_id, owner_staff_id) WHERE room_type = 'ai' AND owner_staff_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_staff_hub_rooms_all ON staff_hub_rooms (organization_id) WHERE room_type = 'all' AND unit_id IS NULL AND job_code IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_staff_hub_rooms_unit_kind ON staff_hub_rooms (organization_id, room_type, unit_id) WHERE unit_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_staff_hub_rooms_job ON staff_hub_rooms (organization_id, job_code) WHERE room_type = 'job' AND job_code IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_staff_hub_rooms_custom_owner ON staff_hub_rooms (organization_id, owner_staff_id) WHERE room_type = 'custom' AND owner_staff_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX ix_staff_hub_rooms_active_type ON staff_hub_rooms (organization_id, is_active, room_type)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_staff_hub_rooms_self ON staff_hub_rooms (organization_id, owner_staff_id) WHERE room_type = 'self' AND owner_staff_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE staff_hub_ocr_correction_memories (

CREATE INDEX ix_staff_hub_ocr_correction_memories_lookup ON staff_hub_ocr_correction_memories (organization_id, occurrence_count, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE auth_sessions (

	FOREIGN KEY(impersonated_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_auth_sessions_token_hash ON auth_sessions (token_hash)

CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id UUID,

CREATE TABLE bulk_transfer_batches (

	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_by_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	original_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,

	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_bulk_transfer_batch_recent ON bulk_transfer_batches (organization_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE staff_service_assignments (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	staff_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source_account_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	service_period_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	service_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	business_unit_id UUID, 
	department_unit_id UUID, 
	floor_unit_id UUID, 
	team_unit_id UUID, 
	job_code VARCHAR(80), 
	job_title_snapshot VARCHAR(100), 
	position_code_id UUID, 
	position_title_snapshot VARCHAR(100), 
	start_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	end_date DATE, 
	assignment_basis VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE INDEX ix_staff_service_assignments_staff_dates ON staff_service_assignments (staff_id, service_type, start_date, end_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_staff_service_assignments_open_service ON staff_service_assignments (staff_id, service_type) WHERE end_date IS NULL

CREATE INDEX ix_voice_call_invitations_org_state_expires ON voice_call_invitations (organization_id, state, expires_at)

CREATE TABLE resident_care_planning_states (
	id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	resident_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	document_type VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	assessment_date DATE, 
	valid_until DATE, 
	next_due_date DATE, 
	cycle_months INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reassess_on_state_change BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	state_change_triggered BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	change_reason TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_refs JSONB NOT NULL, 
	known_facts JSONB NOT NULL, 
	questions_required JSONB NOT NULL, 
	professional_review_fields JSONB NOT NULL, 
	author_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	author_verified_by_id UUID, 
	author_verified_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_test_data BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_resident_care_planning_document UNIQUE (organization_id, resident_id, document_type), 
	CONSTRAINT resident_care_planning_document_type_check CHECK (document_type IN ('cognitive_function_assessment', 'fall_risk_assessment', 'pressure_ulcer_risk_assessment', 'needs_assessment', 'long_term_care_service_plan')), 
	CONSTRAINT resident_care_planning_status_check CHECK (status IN ('not_started', 'draft', 'needs_review', 'confirmed')), 
	CONSTRAINT resident_care_planning_cycle_check CHECK (cycle_months >= 1 AND cycle_months <= 24),

CREATE FUNCTION prevent_confirmed_record_history_mutation()
        RETURNS trigger
        LANGUAGE plpgsql
        AS $$
        BEGIN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'confirmed record history is append-only; create a new version';
        END;
        $$

CREATE TRIGGER trg_confirmed_record_versions_append_only
        BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON staff_hub_confirmed_record_versions
        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_confirmed_record_history_mutation()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_confirmed_record_sources_append_only
        BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON staff_hub_confirmed_record_sources
        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_confirmed_record_history_mutation()
